body: # *The Information* (website). ***The Information***, legally the **Lessin Media Company**, is an American technology industry–focused business publication headquartered in San Francisco. Founded in 2013 by journalist Jessica Lessin, the publication publishes content behind a paywall that allows subscribers access to the site and access to global networking events. Lessin has stated that she aims to "build the next *Wall Street Journal* over the next 50 years" with the publication. Jessica Lessin, a former reporter for *The Wall Street Journal*, founded *The Information* as a subscription-based news website marketed to technology-sector executives in December 2013. Lessin has stated that she wants *The Information* to eventually reach the point where it is spending more than either *The Wall Street Journal* or *The New York Times*, and stated "Our ambition isn't to build a subscription business — our goal is to build the most impactful news organization for the next century".

Overview:
The Information is a global publication committed to original reporting and in-depth analysis of the technology industry. Based in San Francisco and founded in 2013 by award-winning former Wall Street Journal reporter Jessica Lessin, The Information is one of the most influential voices in technology news and one of the fastest-growing news businesses in the world. In addition to delivering leading-edge journalism, the team hosts events and conference calls that draw thousands of C-level leaders annually. # The Information: Tech News. The Information is the most trusted source for original tech news and business reporting — read first thing every morning by the founders, CEOs, venture capital investors, and operators who move the industry. If you care about getting the news first and trusting the source, this is your app. While other outlets aggregate and republish, our reporters develop original scoops you won't find anywhere else: deep investigations into Big Tech, profiles of the founders building the next generation of companies, and rigorous analysis of the deals, fundings, and power shifts shaping technology and business. - TITV: live and on-demand video, including interviews and analysis with our reporters and the people in the news. The Information is more than a publication — it's the daily edge for people who can't afford to be last to know on AI, venture capital, crypto, and the deals shaping tech and business. Subscribe in the app and read the news that's first, and most trusted.
